clue.text: Intervals of quiet amid chatter (4)

indicators.note: something amid something else sits in the middle of it

blocks.note: to gas is to chatter idly
p (piano) is the musical mark for quiet

explanation.surface: Pauses in a noisy conversation.
explanation.walkthrough: "Intervals of quiet" reads as one phrase, but "of" belongs to the definition's side and "quiet" is only the P.
explanation.definitionFit: Gaps are intervals, breaks between one thing and the next.

blocks.note: G is short for grand, a thousand

a plate is a dish
last letter of edged

explanation.surface: An old serving dish with a gilded rim.
explanation.walkthrough: "Edged in gilt" looks like one description of the dish, but "in" just links the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something gold-plated is covered in a thin layer of gold, which is what gilt means.

clue.text: Authors crossing river, small and stony (9)

explanation.walkthrough: "Stony" looks like it describes the river, but it is the definition: stony broke means penniless.

clue.text: Former noble that is first to retire (7)

first letter of retire

clue.text: Issue created by returned egg deliveries (4-4,6)

definitions.text: Issue created by returned egg deliveries

blocks.note: the surface suggests a problem arising; issue is also offspring, children
not parcels sent back but eggs fertilised in a lab and returned to the womb, then delivered as babies

explanation.surface: Offspring of eggs that were sent back.
explanation.walkthrough: The picture is of parcels returned to sender; really the eggs are taken out, fertilised in the lab, and put back in the womb, and the births that follow are the deliveries.
explanation.definitionFit: Test-tube babies are children (issue) born after IVF, where fertilised eggs are returned to the mother.

clue.text: Blade that turns both ways (5)

explanation.walkthrough: A rotor really does turn, so the indicator doubles as a fair description of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A rotor is the rotating blade assembly of a helicopter, or a single blade of it.

clue.text: Boot bag (4)

clue.text: Runner one must keep going after (7)
